specification.title: Conflicting provider reputation is an explicit contradiction
specification.description: A strong malicious reputation signal from one provider and a valid no-hit from another must be represented as an explicit contradiction: one SUPPORTING Finding and one CONTRADICTING Finding.
specification.purpose: Verify the analyst represents a strong malicious signal and a valid no-hit from different providers as an explicit two-sided contradiction instead of silently preferring one source.
specification.operational_relevance: Provider reputation data routinely conflicts; a sound investigation must preserve both sides so downstream reviewers can weigh the disagreement.
specification.regression_risk: The analyst could treat observations from different providers as simultaneous compatible state, drop the no-hit, or omit the contradicting side of the Assessment.

required: The Assessment represents both the supporting and the contradicting reputation observations
The Assessment verdict is drawn only from the declared inconclusive, suspicious, or malicious envelope
forbidden: The Assessment silently discards the valid no-hit observation
The Assessment hides the contradiction by using only one side of the disagreement

fixture.objective: Assess the target IP given directly conflicting reputation observations.
